title: Infinite-to-finite cross-lane routing and owner-boundary transfer
question: How should an infinite-to-finite formulation be transferred to the main Q3, TECT-Yang-Mills hybrid, and Yang-Mills owner lanes without turning a top-down ansatz into a circular proof?
method: Separate top-down necessary-condition and compatibility use from the proof-bearing finite-to-infinite construction.
Route the main Q3 lane through finite projections, two-sign/source/orientation tests, uniform bounds, common-core transfer, and exhaustion before QFT promotion.
Route the hybrid lane through exact parent reductions, gauge-invariant observables, real-time reconstruction, reflection positivity, and regulator/volume/temperature uniformity.
Preserve the Yang-Mills owner boundary and add only a reference pointer; do not copy or mutate Yang-Mills claims or obligations.
Record stop conditions for dropped terms, hidden time identifications, missing observables, and absent reverse-limit uniformity.
finding: An infinite-to-finite route is useful as a reference-only constraint and falsification sieve, but it does not prove existence of the infinite theory. The proof-bearing bridge still requires finite-to-infinite uniform estimates, common-core/domain transfer, and limit independence. The three lanes can share this routing policy without sharing claim ownership.
decision_reason: The transfer policy makes the direction of proof explicit and prevents finite hybrid or Q3 passes from being promoted through an assumed continuum theory. It supplies a reusable cross-lane strategy and preserves the existing TECT--Yang-Mills owner firewall, but changes no mathematical tier.
boundary: Strategy and routing only. No infinite-dimensional existence theorem, Yang-Mills result, TECT production owner, Q3 common-alpha result, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, mass gap, continuum limit, C6, Sector A, or Pre-A closure follows.
next_action: Main Q3: prove or refute source/volume-uniform modular history and the truncated-CCR common-core tail condition. Hybrid: keep HYB-00--HYB-04 finite and require parent-limit and observable-map crosswalk before HYB-05 or continuum work. Yang-Mills owner: assess only through the existing IF-TECT-YM-0001 pointer.
no_overclaim: This is a claim-nonbearing cross-lane strategy record. Top-down infinite-to-finite compatibility is not a constructive QFT or Yang-Mills proof.

qft_interface.closed: The route order and non-circular evidence role are fixed: top-down necessary conditions followed by proof-bearing finite-to-infinite limits.
qft_interface.open: Uniform Q3 modular history, CCR/domain transfer, common alpha, parent-limit recovery, observable bridge, OS/KMS/GNS, physical-sector gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A and Yang-Mills obligations.
qft_interface.route: Top-down infinite constraints -> finite projections and falsification -> uniform finite-to-infinite bridge -> common alpha -> OS/KMS/GNS -> physical gap -> continuum.

adversarial_review.check: An assumed infinite theory is not treated as proof of its own existence or of its finite approximants.
Uniform bounds, common-core transfer and exhaustion independence remain mandatory and open.
The hybrid lane remains candidate-only and does not alter either parent repository's claims.
Only the existing interface pointer is used; no counterpart source or obligation is copied or mutated.
OS/KMS/GNS, physical gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
